contentPattern.structure: Premium estimator matching the insureshield.com shipping-insurance hero. Per-package card (package-value range slider over a histogram, value x rate / 100) whose CTA opens a side sheet with the monthly estimate (package value + shipments-a-week range sliders, shipments x 52 / 12 x value x rate / 100). One row per item, cells [type | label/content | value]; card rows: heading, value, result, cta, disclaimer; config: rates; sheet rows: quote-heading, quote-value, quote-volume, quote-result, quote-disclaimer, quote-cta, quote-form (PLACEHOLDER Build a quote form)
